B1.name: Sword Play
B1.description: {{nickname}} shows the sheer skill of the greatest swordsman to exist, dealing normal damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Slash in several quick arcs in front, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Lunges as a piercing thrust, increasing piercing by +% for this stage and dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Create an illusion of two swords striking on either side, each dealing % of attack as damage and applying [Dazed] on hit opponents. The duration of effect extends by 3 seconds when dealing elemental damage. Each level of this Basic Skill will increase the duration by an additional 1 second(s).

S1.name: Fire Increaser
S1.description: {{nickname}} takes {{possessive}} customized Fire Increaser and releases the built-up chemicals as fire, dealing AoE [Fire] damage equal to % of attack.

additional.text: This attack can be used by paying stamina when {{nickname}} has no base MP.
When the [Inferno] effect is active, AoE damage becomes massive and deals +100% more damage.

S2.name: Meteor Shower
S2.description: Light the sky with sparkling fire lights, showering down upon the battlefield in a large randomized AoE, dealing massive [Normal] and [Fire] AoE damage equal to % of attack per hit.

additional.text: When holding skill, consume a portion of mana to deal the same damage but shoot a single fireball as ranged damage.

After gaining [Inferno] for the first time, instead, {{nickname}} will sacrifice all of {{possessive}} health, reducing to 1 health and gaining [Indestructible], and change Ultimate Skill slot to Ultimate Skill: Hellflame Meteor which has a single use.

Ultimate Skill: Hellflame Meteor - Mustering mana, a ginormous meteor of gigantic proportions is summed and hurled towards the field directly before {{nickname}}, dealing % of attack as [Fire] large AoE damage plus the value of [Shield] on self added to base damage. This Skill requires a filled meter of “Fighting Spirit” to additionally activate. Every hit from attacks by the team (on-field or off-field) contributes to filling the meter.
Hold Mana Cost: 40 MP per fireball

U1.name: Limitless Nova Beam
U1.description: Stand there in intimidation, almost burning the atmosphere, dealing [Fire] damage equal to % of attack in a small AoE in front.

additional.text: When the [Inferno] effect is active, launch a condensed inferno fire beam from the chest to opponents, increasing AoE, dealing +% additional damage. The attack lingers for 3 seconds and deals damage in intervals of 1 second. Deals damage in 0.5 second intervals if against a single opponent.

T1.name: Flame Reincarnation
T1.description: <u>Ability</u>: Even weaknesses can be overcome by sheer unwavering will. {{nickname}} reduces the opponent’s attack potency.

additional.text: {{nickname}} slashes with a deadly blow, dealing normal damage equal to 330% of attack that ignores all of the opponent's defense, inflicting [Weakened]. The damage increases by the value of [Shield] on {{nickname}}, added to base damage. Skill’s damage will increase by +10% for each level of equipped Basic Skill.
Resonance: Any character can utilize this ability but the damage stays as normal damage and the additional damage increase is still based on the character’s [Shield].

Dupes.description: When health reaches below 30%, permanently gain the [Inferno] effect which cannot be removed and a [Shield] equal to 33% of defense stat.

additional.text: {{nickname:c6}} gains +3% piercing for each percentage of damage increase from {{possessive:c6}} skills or any buffs (any mentioned elemental damage increase does not apply towards the count).

When using the Dash Skill during the [Inferno] state, additionally leave a wide trail of flames behind distance traveled, lasting the duration of the battle, that will deal continuous [Fire] damage equal to 100% of self’s attack per second (can crit) and decrease opponent movement speed by -25%.

After obtaining base MP stat from the [Inferno] effect, regain 3 MP for each successful Basic Skill stage hit. The trail of flames from dashing will now be considered Basic Skill damage and become larger.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
The Technical Skill: Flame Reincarnation will automatically bring {{nickname}}’ health down to 30% and activate the [Inferno] and [Bandage] effects.
The [Burn] effect will be enhanced to [Burn II]. It cannot be removed using regular debuff clearing effects. Skills deal +130% more damage on opponents with the debuff [Electrocute].
